biggest_catch: Referral bonuses are paid no earlier than 120 days after the referral account opening — a four-month wait.
catches: Referral bonuses are paid no earlier than 120 days after the referral account opening.
Friend-side bar is high: 20 debit card uses over a 90-day promotional period (ATM excluded), e-Statement opt-in, and two $500+ direct deposits into the checking account within 90 days of opening.
Must be a member for 30 days before referring.
Offer valid for online account openings only; Texas residents only.
$50 referral bonuses may be taxable interest.
Existing UHCU members cannot be referred; previous members whose accounts closed within 90 days are ineligible.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: UHCU's official member-referral page (uhcu.org/landing/member-referral) pays the referrer $50 for each friend referred, up to 10 friends per calendar year.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: $50 for each friend referred through the Refer a Friend offer, up to 10 friends per calendar year ($500).

c3.evidence: Mechanism: the member refers friends through the Refer a Friend offer; newly referred members also receive a $50 bonus if qualifications are met.

c4.evidence: Timing: referral bonuses are paid no earlier than 120 days after the referral account opening.

eligibility: UHCU members (30 days before referring); the referred person must be a new member meeting the qualification requirements (Texas residents, online openings).
notes: UHCU is University Federal Credit Union (Texas). Distinct from R0882 (MSU FCU student page).
payout_quote: Earn up to $500: You can receive $50 for each friend you refer through this Refer a Friend offer, up to 10 friends per calendar year. Newly referred members will also receive $50 bonus, if qualifications are met.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Referral is free; no cost to refer.

s3.note: $50 referral bonuses may be taxable interest.

s4.note: Cap: up to 10 friends per calendar year ($500).

s5.note: Program live on the current official page (observed 2026-09-23); programs are subject to change without notice.

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on the official page: refer friends through the Refer a Friend offer.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: use the debit card 20 times over a 90-day promotional period (ATM excluded), opt in to e-Statements, and set up direct deposit with a minimum of two $500 direct deposits into the checking account within 90 days of account opening.

steps: Refer a friend through UHCU's Refer a Friend offer.
Friend opens a new checking account online and completes the qualifications within 90 days.
You receive $50 per referred friend (paid no earlier than 120 days after account opening), up to 10 per year.
timing: Referral bonuses are paid no earlier than 120 days after the referral account opening.
